workflow: Operator-assisted host execution using Simjecture tools and skills, custom coupling/analysis scripts and a native WarpX binary.
human_framing: Improve a Qin-1 wire-array/magnetic-obstacle design for plasma deflection and a clear boundary; select the 2026 short-circuit condition; Al or W wires with other source parameters unknown; authorize overnight exploration.
agent_work: CAD variants, coupled EM/circuit solves, field transfer, native 3D plasma controls, analysis, recovery and illustrated reporting.
review: Numerical controls, artifact checks and report inspection by the working assistant; no separate formal scientific adjudication.

software.CAD_and_mesh: Gmsh/OpenCASCADE; FreeCAD was not used for these geometry edits.

WarpX.model: Native 3D CUDA hybrid PIC; not the packaged 2D PICMI capability.

software.FLASH: Local source assessed; no FLASH plasma evolution in this study.

selected_design.feeds: paired; fixture and clearance changes required

coupling: One-way: full retained-device magnetic field at 500 ns, held fixed on a separate plasma clock. No plasma-to-circuit feedback.

source_anchor.status: Published anchor selected by operator; effective capacitance and fixture mapping remain assumptions.

public_excerpt: Selected numerical histories, comparison metrics, checks, source identities, figures and viewer. Raw fields, CAD, installed solvers and private host paths are not distributed here; this is not a turnkey solver rerun.
